items.title: the figures of arXiv:2512.14649 from our runs
items.task: This package belongs to the full reproduction of two papers that the user asked for on 2026-11-22 (coord/DECISIONS/0028): arXiv:2512.14649, 'Stochastic Inflation in Numerical Relativity' (source /data/haiyangw/nrpic/kb-data/raw/arxiv/2512.14649/v2/src/PRD_v2.tex, 791 lines) and arXiv:2401.08530, 'Stochastic Inflation in General Relativity' (source /data/haiyangw/nrpic/kb-data/raw/arxiv/2401.08530/v2/src/Stochastic_Inflation.tex, 1079 lines); the companion on initial conditions, arXiv:2502.06783, is in the store too (kb-data/raw/arxiv/2502.06783/). The sources are read-only and never copied into git; their figures are never committed, and nothing read off a figure is committed as a data file (single comparison values with their locator may stand in text). The authors' code is not public and their random realisations are their own: agreement is statistical, against the linear solution, and against the numbers the papers print. This track has already reproduced both scenarios of the first paper against the linear solution (ladder/, usr/, g2prod/, window/, a4res/, spec/scope/SCOPE.md, note/): build on that and do not redo it. A lead session of this owner may be working in the worktree beside you: commit path-limited, only your package directory and your run manifests. PACKAGE repro/figs: every figure of arXiv:2512.14649 remade from our runs in the paper's layout and our style, and every analysis-only row of the map. Inputs: repro/scope/REPRO_MAP.md, HANDOFF.md (per figure: run ids, files, reader), SETUP_AUDIT.md, CARD_PLAN.md, JOURNAL.md entry 1 (predictions P1 to P7). First close the card runs of repro/scope that have ended (harness/bin/nrpic-run finish; actual costs into CARD_PLAN.md if its sequencer has not done so) and judge its predictions. Then, by registered analysis runs on processors (at most 6 cores; read 256-cell dumps one at a time): Fig. 1, the mean rolls at 64 cells (potential, first and second slow-roll parameter against e-folds, with the Friedmann solution) for both scenarios; Figs. 2 and 4, percentile contours (68, 95, 99, 100) against e-folds of the contrasts of the field, its momentum and the extrinsic curvature, of the reconstructed R, and of the constraints relative to their absolute magnitudes; Figs. 3 and 5, the binned dimensionless spectra of the reconstructed R against the linear solution from the initial to the final time (bins with more than ten modes; the band is the full range in a bin), panels as in the paper; Fig. 6, the spectra of the anisotropic sector for both scenarios; Fig. 7, the convergence of the spectrum; Fig. 8, the convergence of the constraints for both scenarios; Fig. 9, the ablation of the stochastic backreaction: from the runs of package repro/ablation (its HANDOFF.md: three levels for each scenario at 256 cells with the mode equation of the noise on the mesh, made with the executable of branch core/noise-level2; level 2 and level 1 are compared with level 0 on the mesh, coord/DECISIONS/0031), and beside it the level-1 runs of repro/scope against the released level 0; close the ablation runs that have ended (harness/bin/nrpic-run finish) and judge the predictions of repro/ablation/JOURNAL.md; a run that has not ended is marked pending with what reads it. For each figure: look at ours and at the paper's (open the paper's figure file in the store to look at it; never copy it), and write what agrees and by which measure, what differs and why, naming each of the four set-up differences of the audit where it matters. RESULTS.md: verdict per figure and per statement of the map (REPRODUCED, IN PART, NOT REPRODUCED, PENDING) with a ledger (number, run id, script). figures/ with scripts that a reader can rerun; README.md; JOURNAL.md with predictions before each analysis. Follow the skill's procedure for a paper written from scratch (its section 10.1: the short versions first; reviewers as parallel subagents if this session can start them, otherwise say so), the voice pass (10.2), the checker, compile, and read every rendered page. Deliver manuscript/main.pdf and say in README.md how to rebuild it. PACKAGE repro/verify: the fresh verifier of the reproduction. Trust nothing: do not read the READMEs' verdicts, RESULTS.md, the note's text or the journals before your own verdicts are committed (take from them only the list of claims and the locations of raw outputs). Predictions first. With short code of your own (readers of your own; the packages' readers only after a test on an analytic field): (1) arXiv:2401.08530: that the paper's background reaches the slope of its potential only with a forward Euler step of 0.01 e-folds and the converged background stops on the plateau; that its figures are matched by the Ito reading of the printed equations and not by the Stratonovich reading (decide from the paper's own figures by looking at them, and say how firmly); the factor of the Ito term (alpha^5 against the printed alpha^3) by a derivation and a Monte Carlo test of your own; the noise amplitude of appendix D in slow roll and ultra-slow roll against your own solution of the mode equation. (2) arXiv:2512.14649: from the raw dumps of the 256-cell runs, the spectrum of the reconstructed R against the linear solution per mode and per bin at the final time for both scenarios; the freezing of R; the constraint ratios and their absolute magnitudes; the sign-flip control; the difference between backreaction levels; two numbers of the convergence figures; the slow-roll parameters at the final time. (3) A sample of six of the seventeen misprints of repro/equations/ERRATA.md, each rederived. (4) Every number of the note's ledger that you did not cover above, by rerunning its script, and ten of them from raw outputs. VERIFIER.md: what was checked and how, per claim CONFIRMED, NOT CONFIRMED or WRONG with the evidence, what could not be checked, the three weakest points of the reproduction. Registered runs; figures looked at. The five continued runs are still pending (cards blocked): verify what exists.
